questions.q: If A's income is $20\%$ more than B's and B earns $\text{Rs. } 50,000$, what percent less is B's income than A's? (CHSL TIER I - 24/11/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yaha 50,000 sirf tera time waste karne ke liye diya hai! Jab options percentage me ho, toh actual value ka koi kaam nahi. A bada hai, wapas B pe aana hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Seedha CPR thok! Increase hai $+20\% = +\frac{1}{5}$. Toh decrease hoga $-\frac{1}{6}$. Aur $\frac{1}{6}$ hota hai seedha $16.66\%$. Without pen solve hoga ye!

Mathematically :-
$\text{Inc} = +\frac{1}{5}$
$\text{Dec} = -\frac{1}{6} = 16.66\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Maan le B ki income 100 hai, toh A ki 120 hogi. B kitna kam hai? 20 kam hai. Par kis base pe? A ke base pe (120). Fraction bana de.

Mathematically :-
$A = 120$
$B = 100$
$\text{Diff} = 20$
$\% = \frac{20}{120} \times 100 = 16.66\%$

Exam Takeaway: Useless absolute values ko exam me humesha ignore marna seekh. Percentage to Percentage conversion me base shift kaam aata hai!

CPR ShiftFraction
Increase$+1/5$
Decrease$-1/6 = 16.66\%$

questions.q: A has some coins. He gives half of the coins and 3 more to B. B gives half of the coins and 3 more to C. C gives half of the coins and 3 more to D. The number of coins D has now is the smallest two digit number. How many coins does A have in the beginning?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, aage se jaayega (x maan ke) toh equation me ulajh jayega. D ka final number pata hai (10). Peeche se ulta chalna start kar, options apne aap eliminate honge.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Reverse operations laga. D ke paas 10 hain. C ne aadhe diye aur 3 aur diye, toh pehle 3 wapas le (10-3=7) fir double kar (14). Same B aur A ke liye repeat maar. Mind me calculate hoga!

Mathematically :-
$D = 10$
$C = (10 - 3) \times 2 = 14$
$B = (14 - 3) \times 2 = 22$
$A = (22 - 3) \times 2 = 38$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar equation banayega toh step-by-step variables lene padenge. Ise solve karna exam me maut hai. Reverse logic hi tera sahara hai.

Mathematically :-
$\frac{\frac{\frac{x}{2} - 3}{2} - 3}{2} - 3 = 10$
$x = 38$

Exam Takeaway: Chain sharing wale questions me hamesha end point se reverse gear daal diya kar!

StepReverse Operation
Given Half + 3$\text{Value} - 3 \rightarrow \times 2$

questions.q: Number of females in a city is $22.22\%$ less than the number of male and the percentage of the children among male and female are $25\%$ and $40\%$ respectively. If the number of adults in the city is 76650, then find the number of children in the city?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $22.22\%$ dekhte hi dimaag me $2/9$ aana chahiye. Males ko base 9 maan, toh females 7 hongi. Calculation asaan karne ke liye 900 aur 700 maan le.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): M=900, F=700. Children $25\%$ and $40\%$ hain toh Adults kitne honge? $75\%$ and $60\%$. Adult sum nikal ke real value se equate kar de. 1 unit aate hi children ke total se multiply maar.

Mathematically :-
$M=900, F=700$
$\text{Child M} = 900 \times 0.25 = 225$
$\text{Child F} = 700 \times 0.40 = 280$
$\text{Total Child} = 505$
$\text{Adult} = 1095 \equiv 76650$
$1 \text{ unit} = 70$
$\text{Ans} = 505 \times 70 = 35350$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fraction ko theek se tod: Adult M nikal aur Adult F nikal. Total adults ki imaginary unit ko 76650 se compare karke unitary method lagana hai.

Mathematically :-
$\text{Adult M} = 900 \times 0.75 = 675$
$\text{Adult F} = 700 \times 0.60 = 420$
$\text{Total Adults} = 1095 \equiv 76650$
$1 \text{ unit} = 70$
$\text{Children} = (900-675) + (700-420) = 505$
$\text{Ans} = 505 \times 70 = 35350$

Exam Takeaway: Jab decimals me percentage aaye toh base humesha aisi unit lo jo fraction ke denominator ka multiple ho (yaha 9).

FractionValue
$22.22\%$$2/9$

questions.q: If first number is $8\frac{1}{3}\%$ less than third number and ratio of second and third number is 15:16 then average of first and third number is how much percent less/more than second number?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $8\frac{1}{3}\%$ hota hai $1/12$. Matlab 1st aur 3rd ka ratio 11:12 hai. Udhar 2nd aur 3rd ka 15:16 hai. Third number ko equal kar, sab sort ho jayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): 12 aur 16 ka LCM 48 hota hai. 3rd ko 48 banayega toh 1st = 44, 2nd = 45 aayega. 1st aur 3rd ka average = 46. 46, 45 se 1 zyada hai 45 pe. $1/45$ seedha $2.22\%$ deta hai.

Mathematically :-
$I:III = 11:12 = 44:48$
$II:III = 15:16 = 45:48$
$\text{Avg}(I, III) = 46$
$\text{Diff} = 46 - 45 = 1$
$\% = \frac{1}{45} \times 100 = 2.22\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ratio balancing aani chahiye. $A:C = 11:12$ aur $B:C = 15:16$. C common hai, toh usey same bana. Fir simply percentage change nikal de naye base B par.

Mathematically :-
$C = 48$
$A = 44$
$B = 45$
$\frac{44+48}{2} = 46$
$\frac{46-45}{45} \times 100 = 2.22\%$

Exam Takeaway: Ratio ko merge karne ke liye humesha LCM ka base shift method use kiya kar, x maan ke mat beth jana!

RatiosScaled
I : III = 11 : 12$44 : 48$
II : III = 15 : 16$45 : 48$

questions.q: A value is increased by $30\%$ and then decreased by an unknown percentage to return to the original value. What is the percentage decrease required? (CGL TIER I - 23/09/2025-SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh TestRipper, 100 se 130 gaya. Wapas 100 aane ke liye 30 kam karna padega, par naye base yani 130 par. Denominator me 13 aayega, option check maar!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): CPR use kar. Increase $+3/10$ hua hai, toh wapas lane wala decrease $-3/13$ hoga. $300/13$ sidha $23.08\%$ hota hai. Pen ki koi zarurat nahi thi isme.

Mathematically :-
$\text{Inc} = +\frac{3}{10}$
$\text{Dec} = -\frac{3}{13}$
$\% = \frac{300}{13} = 23.07\% \approx 23.08\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Value maan le. Initial = 100. New = 130. Decrease = 30. Percentage Drop = $(30 / 130) \times 100$.

Mathematically :-
$I = 100$
$F = 130$
$\text{Dec} = 30$
$\% = \frac{30}{130} \times 100 = 23.08\%$

Exam Takeaway: Denominator observe karte hi option mark karna aadat bana le, pura calculate karke PhD nahi karni hai.

CPR ChangeValue
Forward$+3/10$
Backward$-3/13$

questions.q: A logistics firm dispatches 15 Light-Duty trucks and 6 Heavy-Duty trucks for a specific route. The payload capacity of a Light-Duty truck is 20% of a Heavy-Duty truck, yielding a combined total payload of 225 tons.\n\nIf the payload capacity of the Heavy-Duty trucks is enhanced by 12%, by what percentage must the fleet of Light-Duty trucks be reduced to keep the overall payload exactly at 225 tons? (Assuming the capacity of Light-Duty trucks and the count of Heavy-Duty trucks are strictly constant).
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation over $A imes B + C imes D = K$ Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yahan Total Payload = Trucks $ imes$ Capacity hai. Overall target fix rakhna hai (225 tons). Heavy trucks ki capacity 12% badhi aur unki sankhya same hai, toh Heavy trucks ka total payload exactly 12% badhega. Jo extra wazan Heavy trucks uthayenge, exactly utna hi wazan Light trucks ko kam uthana padega taki total fix rahe. Seedha initial payload ratio nikal aur shift (deviation) balance kar de. 225 ka exam me koi kaam nahi hai, bas time-waste trap hai! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Seedha product ratio nikal kar deviation ko balance kar de, exact data ki zarurat hi nahi hai. Mathematically :-
$ ext{Capacity Ratio (Light : Heavy)} = 20\% = 1 : 5$ $ ext{Payload Ratio (Light : Heavy)} = (15 imes 1) : (6 imes 5) = 15 : 30 = 1 : 2$ $ ext{Extra payload by Heavy} = 12\% ext{ of } 2 = +0.24 ext{ units}$ $ ext{Loss required by Light} = -0.24 ext{ units}$ $\% ext{ reduction in Light} = rac{0.24}{1} imes 100 = 24\%$ Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable $x$ maan kar total payload equate kar, naya target nikal aur percentage check kar. Mathematically :-
$ ext{Let Capacity Light} = 1x, ext{Capacity Heavy} = 5x$ $ ext{Total Payload} = 15(1x) + 6(5x) = 45x$ $45x = 225 \implies x = 5$ $ ext{Initial Payload Light} = 15 imes 5 = 75$ $ ext{Initial Payload Heavy} = 6 imes 25 = 150$ $ ext{New Capacity Heavy} = 25 imes 1.12 = 28$ $ ext{New Payload Heavy} = 6 imes 28 = 168$ $ ext{Required Payload Light} = 225 - 168 = 57$ $ ext{New Count of Light Trucks} = rac{57}{5} = 11.4 ext{ trucks}$ $\% ext{ Reduction} = rac{15 - 11.4}{15} imes 100 = 24\%$ Exam Takeaway: Method 1 is the ultimate ranker hack. Jab variable $A imes B$ ke form me ho aur ek dimension constant rakhi jaye, toh directly final product ke ratio par base value set karo aur shift ko transfer kar do. Absolute base data (225) ko haath bhi nahi lagana hai.
StepZero-Sum Hack Action
1. Base RatioFind final aggregate ratio ($L : H = 1 : 2$)
2. Find DeviationCalculate exact units gained ($12\%$ of $2 = +0.24$)
3. Balance & ScaleShift the same loss over Light's base ($-0.24 / 1 = 24\%$)

questions.q: A tech company operates a data center with 15 Alpha-servers and 6 Beta-servers. The daily data handling capacity of an Alpha-server is 20% of a Beta-server's capacity, resulting in a fixed total bandwidth of 225 Terabytes.\n\nDue to a software upgrade, the capacity of each Beta-server is increased by 12%. What percentage reduction in the number of Alpha-servers is required to maintain the exact same total bandwidth of 225 Terabytes? (Given that the capacity of Alpha-servers and the number of Beta-servers remain unchanged).
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation over $A imes B + C imes D = K$ Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yahan Total Bandwidth = Servers $ imes$ Capacity per Server hai. Overall limit fix rakhni hai (225 TB). Beta-servers ki capacity 12% badhi aur unki sankhya wahi hai, iska matlab unka total data contribution exactly 12% se jump marega. Data cap ko overflow se bachane ke liye, Alpha-servers ko exactly wahi extra data cut karna padega. Time waste kiye bina directly initial bandwidth ratio nikal! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Mathematically :-
$ ext{Capacity Ratio (Alpha : Beta)} = 20\% = 1 : 5$ $ ext{Bandwidth Ratio (Alpha : Beta)} = (15 imes 1) : (6 imes 5) = 15 : 30 = 1 : 2$ $ ext{Extra bandwidth by Beta} = 12\% ext{ of } 2 = +0.24 ext{ units}$ $ ext{Loss required by Alpha} = -0.24 ext{ units}$ $\% ext{ reduction in Alpha} = rac{0.24}{1} imes 100 = 24\%$ Method 2 (Concept Builder): Mathematically :-
$ ext{Let Capacity Alpha} = 1x, ext{Capacity Beta} = 5x$ $ ext{Total Bandwidth} = 15(1x) + 6(5x) = 45x$ $45x = 225 \implies x = 5$ $ ext{Initial Bandwidth Alpha} = 15 imes 5 = 75$ $ ext{Initial Bandwidth Beta} = 6 imes 25 = 150$ $ ext{New Capacity Beta} = 25 imes 1.12 = 28$ $ ext{New Bandwidth Beta} = 6 imes 28 = 168$ $ ext{Required Bandwidth Alpha} = 225 - 168 = 57$ $ ext{New Count of Alpha Servers} = rac{57}{5} = 11.4 ext{ servers}$ $\% ext{ Reduction} = rac{15 - 11.4}{15} imes 100 = 24\%$ Exam Takeaway: Method 1 is the ultimate ranker hack. Jab variable $A imes B$ ke form me ho aur ek dimension constant rakhi jaye, toh directly final product ke ratio par base value set karo aur shift ko transfer kar do. Absolute base data (225) ko haath bhi nahi lagana hai.
StepZero-Sum Hack Action
1. Base RatioFind final aggregate ratio ($\alpha : eta = 1 : 2$)
2. Find DeviationCalculate exact units gained ($12\%$ of $2 = +0.24$)
3. Balance & ScaleShift the same loss over Alpha's base ($-0.24 / 1 = 24\%$)

questions.q: $62.5\%$ of a number exceeds $25\%$ of the same number by 15. What is the number? (PHASE XIII(GRAD) - 31/07/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, sidha difference dikh raha hai. $62.5\% - 25\% = 37.5\%$. Aur $37.5\%$ ki standard fraction $3/8$ hoti hai. Dimaag me set rakh isko!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): $3/8$ part ki value 15 hai. 3 part 15 hain toh 1 part 5 hoga. Pura number 8 part hai, toh $8 \times 5 = 40$. Seconds ka game hai ye.

Mathematically :-
$62.5\% - 25\% = 37.5\%$
$37.5\% = \frac{3}{8}$
$\frac{3}{8} \equiv 15 \implies 1 \equiv 5$
$\text{Num} = 8 \times 5 = 40$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic equation $0.625x - 0.25x = 15$ likh ke solve kar le. Lekin decimals exam me rulate hain, hamesha fractions use kar.

Mathematically :-
$0.625x - 0.25x = 15$
$0.375x = 15$
$x = \frac{15}{0.375} = 40$

Exam Takeaway: Percentage difference agar standard fraction ho toh seedha numerator-denominator ka khel khel.

PercentFraction
$37.5\%$$3/8$

questions.q: A metallurgist mixes two alloys, A and B, to make a total of 80 kg of a new mixture. Alloy A contains 15% copper, and Alloy B contains 25% copper. If the final mixture contains a total of 15 kg of copper, what is the difference in the weights of Alloy A and Alloy B used?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, mixture dekh ke Alligation yaad aata hai, lekin JSM yahan zyada tez hai kyunki total quantity pata hai. Minimum 15% copper toh dono me hai na!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Base copper 15% maan le. 80kg ka 15% = 12kg. Lekin question bola total 15kg copper hai. Extra kitna? 3kg. Ye extra aya kahan se? Alloy B ke extra 10% (25-15) se. Toh B ka 10% = 3kg $\implies$ B = 30kg. A bacha 50kg. Difference 20kg.

Mathematically :-
$\text{Base} = 15\%$
$\text{Assumed} = 80 \times 0.15 = 12$
$\text{Actual} = 15$
$\text{Extra} = 3$
$10\% \text{ of } B = 3 \implies B = 30$
$A = 50$
$\text{Diff} = 20$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Alligation se karega toh pehle final mixture ka overall percentage nikal, fraction aayega, usme alligate karega toh time lag jayega.

Mathematically :-
$\text{Total Cu } \% = \frac{15}{80} \times 100 = 18.75\%$
$\text{Ratio A:B} = (25 - 18.75) : (18.75 - 15) = 6.25 : 3.75 = 5:3$
$A = 50, B = 30$
$A - B = 20$

Exam Takeaway: Jab bhi do alag percentages ho aur unka overall total number me diya ho, hamesha JSM thok dena, alligation se fast hai.

AlloyJSM Split
B (25%)$15\% + 10\%$

questions.q: The monthly salary of a person was 50,000. He used to spend on three heads-personal and family expenses (E), taxes (T), philanthropy (P), and rest were his savings. E was $50\%$ of the income. T was $20\%$ of E and P was $15\%$ of T. When his salary got raised by $40\%$, he maintained the percentage level of E, but T became $30\%$ of E and P became $20\%$ of T.By what percentage is the new savings more or less than the earlier savings? (correct up to one decimal place)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, fir se exam setter ne 50k deke trap set kiya hai. Answer percentage me chahiye, toh initial salary 100 maan, calculation makkhan ki tarah hogi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Base I=100. E=50. T(20% of 50)=10. P(15% of 10)=1.5. Old Save = 100-61.5 = 38.5. Nayi Income=140. E wahi 50% rahega yani E=70. Naya T(30% of 70)=21. Naya P(20% of 21)=4.2. New Save = 140-95.2 = 44.8. Diff = 6.3. $\frac{6.3}{38.5}$ nikal ke mark kar!

Mathematically :-
$I_1 = 100, E_1 = 50, T_1 = 10, P_1 = 1.5$
$\text{Save}_1 = 100 - 61.5 = 38.5$
$I_2 = 140, E_2 = 70, T_2 = 21, P_2 = 4.2$
$\text{Save}_2 = 140 - 95.2 = 44.8$
$\text{Diff} = 6.3$
$\% = \frac{6.3}{38.5} \times 100 = 16.36\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Pura 50,000 par nikalega, toh end me values hazaaro me chali jayengi fir unka ratio lega toh waise bhi zeros cancel ho jayenge. Gaddha mat khod exam me.

Mathematically :-
$I_1 = 50000$
$\text{Save}_1 = 50000 - 30750 = 19250$
$I_2 = 70000$
$\text{Save}_2 = 70000 - 47600 = 22400$
$\% = \frac{3150}{19250} \times 100 = 16.36\%$

Exam Takeaway: Absolute value avoid kar aur jab parameters interlinked ho, toh bas successive tree banata chal.

StateSavings
Old$38.5$ units
New$44.8$ units

questions.q: A quality control officer tracks the defect rates in 4 different machines in a textile factory. The first machine produces fabrics with an average defect rate of 1.8\%, the second with 2.4\%, and the third with 1.6\%. The fourth machine operated for 5 fewer hours than the average runtime of the first three, yet its total defective output was 0.92 units. If the total number of defective units from all four machines is 4.12, and each machine's total production was identical, find the defect percentage of the fourth machine. (SSC CHSL TIER I - 21/11/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling (Equating imaginary units to real values) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, sabhi 4 machines ka total defect 4.12 hai aur 4th wale ka akela 0.92 hai. Yaani bache hue pehle 3 machines ne milkar 4.12 - 0.92 = 3.2 defective units banaye. Un teeno ka combined percentage 1.8 + 2.4 + 1.6 = 5.8\% hai. Ab agar 3.2 units seedha 5.8\% ko represent kar rahe hain, toh 0.92 units kitne percentage ko represent karega? Total production nikalne ki jarurat hi nahi hai, direct cross-multiply maar! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Bina production P nikaley direct units ko percentage se scale kar do. Mathematically :-
3.2 \text{ units} \xrightarrow{\text{represents}} 5.8\%
1 \text{ unit} \xrightarrow{\text{represents}} \frac{5.8}{3.2}\%
0.92 \text{ units} \xrightarrow{\text{represents}} \left(\frac{5.8}{3.2}\right) \times 0.92 = 1.6675\% \approx 1.67\% Method 2 (Concept Builder): Total production P maan kar solve karna. Yeh tab theek hai jab ghar pe practice kar rahe ho. Mathematically :-
P \times (1.8\% + 2.4\% + 1.6\%) = 4.12 - 0.92
P \times 5.8\% = 3.20 \implies P = \frac{320}{5.8}
\text{Defect \% of 4th} = \left(\frac{0.92}{P}\right) \times 100 = \left(\frac{0.92 \times 5.8}{320}\right) \times 100 = 1.6675\% \approx 1.67\% Exam Takeaway: Jab "total production identical" likha ho, toh units aur percentage directly proportional hote hain. P nikalne par time waste mat kar. Always use the Ratio/Unitary method to jump straight to the answer!
Concept TrickMathematical Shortcut
Direct Proportionality (Production is Constant)$\text{Target \%} = \left( \frac{\text{Total \% of known group}}{\text{Total Units of known group}} \right) \times \text{Units of Target}$

questions.q: The number of peacocks in a bird sanctuary was P in the year 2000. The number decreased by $10\%$ in the next decade and increased by $50\%$ in the decade after that. If the difference between the number of peacocks in the years 2020 and 2000 is 5250, and it increased by $36\%$ in the next half decade, then what is the number of peacocks in the year 2025?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, pehle gira fir utha. Net successive change nikal, P ki value aayegi. Uske baad 2025 ki value aayegi jo 1.36 se multiply karke banegi, jiska unit digit pakad lena hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Net effect = 0.9 x 1.5 = 1.35. Yani 35% bada. $35\% = 5250$ toh $100\% (P) = 15000$. 2020 me = $15000 \times 1.35 = 20250$. Naya 36% bada, $20250 \times 1.36$. Last digit zero ke baad 4 aayega, option B me 40 hai, seedha tick maar!

Mathematically :-
$\text{Net}_1 = 0.9 \times 1.5 = 1.35$
$\text{Diff} = 35\% = 5250 \implies 100\% = 15000$
$P_{2020} = 15000 \times 1.35 = 20250$
$P_{2025} = 20250 \times 1.36 = 27540$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): $P - P(0.9)(1.5)$ likh ke formula banayega, subtract karega toh bhi end me calculation unit digit se hi fast hogi.

Mathematically :-
$P(1.5)(0.9) - P = 5250$
$0.35P = 5250 \implies P = 15000$
$P_{2025} = 15000(1.35)(1.36) = 27540$

Exam Takeaway: Pure multiplication mat kar, Unit digit aur Digital Sum hamesha bachate hain successive problems me.

DecadeMultiplier
2000-2020$1.35x$

questions.q: The town has a present population of 2,40,000. Every year the population increases by $12\%$ and decreases by $7\%$ due to migration. What will be the population after 3 years? (CHSL TIER 1- 19/11/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, aate hain 12 aur jaate hain 7. Net change har saal ka $5\%$ increase hai. 5% = $1/20$, matlab ratio 21/20 banega. 21 matlab 3 ka multiple aur 9 ka DS!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): $240000 \times (21/20)^3$. Yaha 21 cube hai matlab 9 ka multiple aayega fix hai. Options ka Digital Sum (C9) nikal. Option A: $2+7+7+8+3+0 = 27 \implies 9$. Seedha answer hai. Baaki options check bhi mat kar.

Mathematically :-
$\text{Net} = +12\% - 7\% = +5\%$
$A = 240000 \times (\frac{21}{20})^3$
$\text{DS}(21^3) = 9$
$\text{Options DS}: A=9$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Cube solve kar. $9261 / 8000$. Fir 240000 se kaat ke multiply kar, poori mazdoori hai.

Mathematically :-
$A = 240000 \times \frac{9261}{8000}$
$A = 30 \times 9261 = 277830$

Exam Takeaway: Divisibility aur Digital Sum (C9) aisi calculation ko 5 seconds me nikaal dete hain.

CheckResult
Digital Sum$27 \rightarrow 9$

questions.q: A salesman has done total sale of Rs. (x + 17000) and the rate of commission up to Rs. (x + 5000) is $13.33\%$ and after Rs. (x + 5000), he gets some bonus amount which is equal to Rs. (x - 8000). If the bonus rate is $16.66\%$ on the amount exceeding Rs. (x + 5000), then find his total sale.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh TestRipper, 'x' dekh ke darna nahi hai. Dono range '(x+17000)' aur '(x+5000)' form me hain. Difference lega toh x gayab! Seedha excess amount nikal aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Excess sale = $(x + 17000) - (x + 5000) = 12000$. Bonus mila is excess ka $16.66\%$ yani $1/6$. Bonus $= 2000$. Question me bonus $(x - 8000)$ hai. $x - 8000 = 2000 \implies x = 10000$. Total sale thi $x+17000$, seedha 27000 answer mark kar!

Mathematically :-
$\text{Excess} = (x + 17000) - (x + 5000) = 12000$
$\text{Bonus} = 12000 \times \frac{1}{6} = 2000$
$x - 8000 = 2000 \implies x = 10000$
$\text{Total} = 10000 + 17000 = 27000$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Algebraically poori condition likh, rate of commission wagera add kar. Uski yahan zaroorat nahi thi kyunki excess bonus direct de rakha hai aur bonus ki condition bhi.

Mathematically :-
$\text{Total Sale} = S = x + 17000$
$\text{Bonus} = \frac{1}{6}(S - (x + 5000))$
$\text{Bonus} = \frac{12000}{6} = 2000$
$x - 8000 = 2000 \implies x = 10000$
$S = 27000$

Exam Takeaway: Variables dekh kar panic nahi karna, variables difference lete hi khud eliminate ho jate hain.

StepValue
Excess Sale$12000$
Bonus$2000$

questions.q: In sweet, one-third is sugar. If the price of sugar now is $\frac{7}{6}$ of the previous price, what is the effective percentage increase in the cost of the sweet?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, sweet me $\frac{1}{3}$ hissa sugar hai. Change sirf isi hisse me ho raha hai. Fraction ka direct multiply maar de.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Sugar ka price $7/6$ ho gaya matlab increase $1/6$ ka hai. Sweet me sugar ki hissedari $1/3$ hai. Effective net increase $= 1/3 \times 1/6 = 1/18$. Percentage me nikalne ke liye $\times 100$ kar $\implies 100/18 = 50/9 = 100/18\%$ directly options me given hai.

Mathematically :-
$\text{Inc}_s = \frac{7}{6} - 1 = \frac{1}{6}$
$\text{Net Inc} = \frac{1}{3} \times \frac{1}{6} = \frac{1}{18}$
$\% = \frac{1}{18} \times 100 = \frac{100}{18}\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Maan le total sweet 300g hai. Sugar 100g, non-sugar 200g. Price assume kar. Calculation lamba jayega. Weighted average hi ultimate hai.

Mathematically :-
$\text{Let total} = 300g$
$\text{Sugar} = 100g, \text{Other} = 200g$
$\text{Old Cost} = 100(6) + 200(C)$
$\text{New Cost} = 100(7) + 200(C)$
$\text{Diff} = 100$
$\% = \frac{100}{1800} = \frac{100}{18}\%$

Exam Takeaway: Partial changes nikalne ke liye hamesha (Fraction of weight) $\times$ (Fraction of change) use karo.

ComponentValue
Share$1/3$
Increase$1/6$

questions.q: Suhani pays tax at the rate of $30\%$ on her entire income of 90,000 and Ritika pays tax at the rate of $40\%$ on her entire income of y. If the total rate of tax on their combined income becomes $37\%$, then what is the value of y?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 4. Cross-Product Method (Alligation)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab do alag alag percentages combine hoke ek overall percentage de rahe ho, tab bina soche Alligation thok dena chahiye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Suhani 30, Ritika 40. Mix bana 37. Cross me difference le. $40-37 = 3$, aur $37-30 = 7$. Ratio income ka 3:7 aaya. Suhani (3 unit) = 90,000 toh Ritika (7 unit) = 2,10,000. Sidha oraly solve!

Mathematically :-
$\text{Ratio} = (40-37) : (37-30) = 3:7$
$3 \text{ unit} = 90000$
$7 \text{ unit} = 210000$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Weighted average $30(90k) + 40(y) = 37(90k + y)$ banake equation ko balance kar. Wahi answer aayega par time khayega.

Mathematically :-
$30\%(90000) + 40\%(y) = 37\%(90000 + y)$
$27000 + 0.4y = 33300 + 0.37y$
$0.03y = 6300 \implies y = 210000$

Exam Takeaway: Combined averages ke har sawal ka baap Alligation hai, usko base par use karna seekh.

PersonTax Rate
Suhani$30\%$
Ritika$40\%$

questions.q: Ratio of the number of shirts and T-shirts in the bag is 5:4. If the number of shirts in the bag is increased by $60\%$ and the number of T-shirts in the bag is increased by 40, then the ratio of the number of shirts and t-shirts in the bag becomes 2:3. Find the initial number of T-shirts in the bag?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 4. Cross-Product Method

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, ek side par percentage change hai aur dusri side par real value (40) ka increase. Percentage change ko ratio unit me shift karke dono ratios balance karne honge.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Initial = 5:4. Shirts $60\%$ badhi matlab 5 se 8 ho gayi. Naya ratio 2:3 diya hai. Par yahan shirts 8 hain aur naye me 2 dikha raha hai. Ratio ko 4 se multiply karke same kar de $\implies 8:12$. Ab dekh, T-shirts 4 se 12 hui yani 8 unit badhi. Question ke hisaab se 40 badhi. $8=40 \implies 1=5$. Initial T-shirts $4 \times 5 = 20$. Khatam!

Mathematically :-
$\text{Init} = 5:4$
$S_{new} = 5 \times 1.6 = 8$
$\text{New Ratio} = 2:3 = 8:12$
$\text{Diff } T = 12 - 4 = 8 \text{ units}$
$8 \text{ units} = 40 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 5$
$T_{init} = 4 \times 5 = 20$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): $5x$ aur $4x$ maan. $5x$ ka $160\% = 8x$. Fir $(8x)/(4x + 40) = 2/3$. Cross multiply karke x nikal.

Mathematically :-
$\frac{5x \times 1.6}{4x + 40} = \frac{2}{3}$
$\frac{8x}{4x + 40} = \frac{2}{3}$
$24x = 8x + 80 \implies 16x = 80 \implies x = 5$
$T_{init} = 4(5) = 20$

Exam Takeaway: Ratio ko kisi ek common parameter pe balance karna seekh lo, saare x wale methods redundant ho jayenge.

StepRatios (S:T)
Initial$5:4$
Balanced New$8:12$

questions.q: The population of a place increased to 50,000 from 2016 to 2018 at the rate of 6% per annum, and continued the same trend for the next 3 years. If A is the population in 2016 and B is the population in 2020, both are approximated to the next possible integers, then the value of B - A is:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (CI, Area, Successive discounts) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 2018 ki population base de rakhi hai. A (2016) nikalne ke liye backward jana hai aur B (2020) ke liye forward. Options door door hain, exact calculation ekdum crime hai yaha, approximation jhanda gadh dega. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, jo 25493.jpg wali image me approach hai wo ekdum killer hai. Successive change 6\% + 6\% + \frac{6 \times 6}{100} = 12.36\% ka aayega 2 saal me. 2018 ki population fixed 50,000 hai. 2020 tak aage badhe to increment d_2 = 12.36\% hoga 50,000 pe. Aur 2016 se 2018 tak d_1 = 12.36\% badha hoga A pe. Kyunki A < 50,000 hai, toh uska increment d_1, hamesha d_2 se chhota hi hoga. Hamein total diff B-A chahiye jo d_1 + d_2 hai. Yani (B-A) < 2 \times d_2. Seedha option hit kar de! Mathematically :-
d_2 = 12.36\% \times 50000 = 6180 \\ d_1 = 12.36\% \times A < 6180 \quad (\because A < 50000) \\ B - A = d_1 + d_2 < 6180 + 6180 = 12360 \\ \text{Option D } (11680) < 12360 Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ab dekhte hain 25495.jpg wala ratio approximation trick. 12.36\% \approx 12.5\% = \frac{1}{8}. Toh multiplier hua \frac{9}{8}. Seedha base shift kar ratio method se 2018 ko central base bana ke. Mathematically :-
A : 2018 = 8 : 9 \xrightarrow{\times 8} 64 : 72 \\ 2018 : B = 8 : 9 \xrightarrow{\times 9} 72 : 81 \\ A : 2018 : B = 64 : 72 : 81 \\ \text{Diff } = 81 - 64 = 17 \text{ units} \\ B - A = \frac{50000}{72} \times 17 \approx 11805 \\ \text{Closest Option is } 11680 Method 3 (Ninja Pro Max / Video Concept): Dekh bhai video mein AptiMaths wale sir ne kya gazab percentage logic khela hai Q109 ke liye! Pura process base 100 maan ke socho. 2016 ko 100\% maano. 2018 ho gaya 112.36\% jiski value 50,000 de rakhi hai. Hamein diff (B-A) chahiye jo basically lagbhag 26.22\% (12.36 aur 12.36 ka net) aayega. Ab dekho, 112.36\% ko 4 se divide kar de toh 28.09\% mil jayega jiski value 12,500 hui. Toh apna required difference 26.22\% definitely 12,500 se strictly chhota hoga! Mathematically :-
\text{Let } A = 100\% \\ 2018 \text{ Pop } = 100\% + 12.36\% = 112.36\% \equiv 50000 \\ \frac{112.36\%}{4} = 28.09\% \equiv 12500 \\ (B-A)\% \approx 26.22\% < 28.09\% \implies B-A < 12500 Method 4 (Basic Equation): Yeh tera purana 1.1236 wala division method. Majdoori karni hai toh yeh kar le exam me. Mathematically :-
A \approx \frac{50000}{1.1236} \approx 44500 \\ B = 50000 \times 1.1236 = 56180 \\ B - A = 56180 - 44500 = 11680 Method 5 (Fraction Expansion): Formula laga ke step-by-step solve karna ho tab ye kaam ayega, par isse time bahut waste hoga. Mathematically :-
A \times \left(\frac{53}{50}\right)^2 = 50000 \implies A \approx 44499 \\ B = 50000 \times \frac{2809}{2500} = 56180 \\ B - A = 11681 \approx 11680 Exam Takeaway: Approximation using boundary limits (Method 1 & 3) is your absolute ultimate weapon here. Multiplication aur exact decimals ko haath bhi nahi lagana hai.
ConceptShortcut Trigger
Bounding CheckAlways test x + y + \frac{xy}{100} limits before dividing exactly. Check nearest multiples.

questions.q: A fraction $\frac{3}{5}$ is decreased by $\frac{2}{5}$. The resulting fraction is then increased by 20%.\n\nWhat is the percentage decrease/increase in the value of the original fraction?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, base me 5 hai dono jagah. $ rac{3}{5}$ me se $ rac{2}{5}$ gaya toh bacha $ rac{1}{5}$. Ab $ rac{1}{5}$ ko 20% (yani khud ka $ rac{1}{5}$th) badhana hai. Seedha seedha base ko 25 dimaag me soch aur numerators ko 15 aur 6 padh. 15 se 6 hua, matlab 9 ka loss 15 par. $ rac{9}{15}$ seedha 60% hota hai! Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Base same kar lo taaki fractions integers jaise behave karein. Mathematically :-
$ ext{Original} = rac{3}{5} = rac{15}{25}$
$ ext{New} = ( rac{3}{5} - rac{2}{5}) imes 1.2 = rac{1}{5} imes rac{6}{5} = rac{6}{25}$
$\% ext{ Decrease} = rac{15 - 6}{15} imes 100 = 60\%$ Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic se chalte hain. Pehle original fraction me se fraction minus karo, fir jo aaye usko 20% increase karo (multiply by $ rac{6}{5}$). Mathematically :-
$ ext{Original} = rac{3}{5}$
$ ext{After subtraction} = rac{3}{5} - rac{2}{5} = rac{1}{5}$
$ ext{After 20\% increase} = rac{1}{5} imes (1 + rac{20}{100}) = rac{1}{5} imes rac{6}{5} = rac{6}{25}$
$ ext{Absolute Change} = rac{3}{5} - rac{6}{25} = rac{15}{25} - rac{6}{25} = rac{9}{25}$
$ ext{Percentage Change} = rac{ rac{9}{25}}{ rac{15}{25}} imes 100 = rac{9}{15} imes 100 = 60\%$ Exam Takeaway: Is type ke questions me "decreased by a fraction" aur "decreased by a percentage" ka phrasing hi trap hota hai. Hamesha final aur initial fraction ka base same kar lo (jaise yahan humne dono ko 25 bana liya), toh calculation seconds me muh-zabani ho jayegi.
List IList II
Base EqualizationWhenever comparing fractions to find percentage change, equalize their denominators.
Fractional MultiplierFor a 20% increase, directly multiply by $ rac{6}{5}$ instead of calculating 20% and adding it back.

questions.q: Weight of Ayush and Abhishek are in the ratio of 8:5. Abhishek's weight increases by 40 percent and total weight of Ayush and Abhishek both increases by 60 percent. If total weight becomes 104 kg, then what is the weight of Ayush after the increment?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh TestRipper bhai, pure group ka weight 60% bada, par ek banda sirf 40% bada, yani usne apne hisse ka 20% ghapla kiya. Dusre bande ko compensation dena padega!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total deviation = Abhishek ne 5 unit par $-20\%$ ka deficit diya yani $-100\%$. Ye kami Ayush poori karega apne 8 unit par. Toh Ayush badhega $= 60\% + (100/8)\% = 72.5\%$. Total weight naya 104 hai, purana $104/1.6 = 65$ tha. Purana Ayush $= (8/13) \times 65 = 40$. Naya Ayush = $40 \times 1.725 = 69$ kg. Solid concept!

Mathematically :-
$\text{Deficit} = 5 \times (40-60) = -100\%$
$\text{Ayush Inc} = 60 + \frac{100}{8} = 72.5\%$
$\text{Old Total} = \frac{104}{1.6} = 65$
$\text{Old Ayush} = 65 \times \frac{8}{13} = 40$
$\text{New Ayush} = 40 \times 1.725 = 69$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): $8x$ aur $5x$ maan. Dono ko add karke equation set up kar, solve karne me pasina aayega.

Mathematically :-
$8x + 5x = 13x$
$13x \times 1.6 = 104 \implies 20.8x = 104 \implies x = 5$
$\text{Ayush}_{old} = 40, \text{Abhishek}_{old} = 25$
$\text{Abhishek}_{new} = 25 \times 1.4 = 35$
$\text{Ayush}_{new} = 104 - 35 = 69$

Exam Takeaway: JSM Deviation method se badhe se badhe weighted average ke questions tod sakte ho.

PersonIncrement
Abhishek$40\%$
Ayush$72.5\%$

questions.q: The lengths of two adjacent sides of a square are increased by $35\%$ and $25\%$ respectively. As a result the area of the rectangle will be more than the area of the square by?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 2D figure ka area $L \times B$ hota hai. Dono badh rahe hain, toh net successive percentage seedha hit karna hai formula se.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Aankh band karke $A + B + \frac{AB}{100}$ thok de. $35 + 25 + (35 \times 25)/100 = 60 + 8.75 = 68.75\%$. Options me last digit pehchano, pen mat uthana aisi calculations ke liye!

Mathematically :-
$\% = 35 + 25 + \frac{35 \times 25}{100}$
$\% = 60 + 8.75 = 68.75\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Square ki side 100 maan, area 10000. Nayi side 135 aur 125. Multiply kar aur difference dekh kar 100 se divide. Kyu karna itna dukh?

Mathematically :-
$A_{old} = 100 \times 100 = 10000$
$A_{new} = 135 \times 125 = 16875$
$\% = \frac{6875}{10000} \times 100 = 68.75\%$

Exam Takeaway: Area change hamesha $X+Y+XY/100$ format follow karta hai, time and mind space dono save karo.

FormulaApplication
Net Change$A + B + (A \times B)/100$

questions.q: The price of an article increased by $16.66\%$ every year. If the difference between the price at the end of third and fourth year is 126 then 1/8th of the price at the end of second year?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $16.66\%$ badhne ka fraction 1/6 hota hai. Koi chiz 3rd year se 4th year me jayegi, toh kitna badhegi? Apne aap ka 1/6 hi badhegi na! Yahi trick thi isme.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): 4th year aur 3rd year ka difference, purely 3rd year ki value ka $1/6$ hai. Toh $3\text{rd yr} \times 1/6 = 126 \implies 3\text{rd yr} = 756$. Ab isse backward ja 2nd year pe (multiply by 6/7). $756 \times 6/7 = 648$. Iska $1/8$ nikal, $648 / 8 = 81$. Ratio method is supreme!

Mathematically :-
$\text{Diff} = P_3 \times \frac{1}{6} = 126$
$P_3 = 756$
$P_2 = 756 \times \frac{6}{7} = 648$
$\text{Ans} = \frac{648}{8} = 81$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): $P \times (7/6)^3$ aur $P \times (7/6)^4$ leke dono ko minus karke P ki value nikalne jayega toh adha exam wahi khatam ho jayega.

Mathematically :-
$P(1+\frac{1}{6})^4 - P(1+\frac{1}{6})^3 = 126$
$P(\frac{7}{6})^3 (\frac{7}{6} - 1) = 126$
$P_3 \times \frac{1}{6} = 126 \implies P_3 = 756$
$P_2 \times \frac{7}{6} = 756 \implies P_2 = 648$
$\frac{P_2}{8} = 81$

Exam Takeaway: Compound growth me adjacent years ka difference direct fraction increase ki value bata deta hai.

StepMultiplier
Backward Shift$\times 6/7$

questions.q: x is inversely proportional to y. If x is increased by $37.5\%$ then find % change in the value of y?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $x$ aur $y$ inversely proportional hain, iska matlab unka product $x \times y = K$ constant hai. Direct CPR shift lagega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): $37.5\%$ ki fraction $3/8$ hoti hai. X me increase hua $+3/8$. Toh CPR shift me Y decrease hoga $-3/(8+3) = -3/11$. $1/11$ hota hai $9.09\%$, toh $3/11$ banega $27.27\%$. Aankhon hi aankhon me answer!

Mathematically :-
$X_{inc} = +\frac{3}{8}$
$Y_{dec} = -\frac{3}{11}$
$\% = \frac{3}{11} \times 100 = 27.27\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ratio se dekh le. $x$ agar 8 se 11 hua, toh inverse relation me $y$ 11 se 8 hoga. 3 ghata 11 par. Baakhi kahani same hai.

Mathematically :-
$xy = k$
$X_{new} = \frac{11}{8}x$
$Y_{new} = \frac{k}{\frac{11}{8}x} = \frac{8}{11}y$
$\text{Dec} = y - \frac{8}{11}y = \frac{3}{11}y$
$\% = \frac{3}{11} \times 100 = 27.27\%$

Exam Takeaway: Inversely proportional bolne ka matlab hi CPR lagana hai, fractions yaad hone chahiye tips par.

VariableShift
X (Increase)$+3/8$
Y (Decrease)$-3/11$

questions.q: A solution contains $80\%$ acid. How much water must be added to 20 liters of this solution to make acid $50\%$? (CHSL TIER I - 28/11/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 1. CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, mixture me jo cheez fix hai, sirf usko pakad. Paani mila raha hai, matlab Acid ki quantity dono mixtures me bilkul barabar hogi. Equations ki jarurat nahi, ratio equate kar.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pehle Acid 80% (20 Litre ka), ab banega 50% (Total Volume ka). Equation set maar, $20 \times 80\% = (20+W) \times 50\%$. $50\%$ of $20+W$ hai 16 ke barabar, toh $20+W = 32$. Yani W = 12 litre. Direct!

Mathematically :-
$20 \times 80\% = (20+W) \times 50\%$
$16 = (20+W) \times 0.5$
$32 = 20 + W \implies W = 12$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Original me acid $20 \times 0.8 = 16$ litre. Water $4$ litre. Naya water x mila do. Toh naya water $= 4+x$. Naya total $= 20+x$. Proportion $= 16 / (20+x) = 1/2$. Cross multiply se aayega answer.

Mathematically :-
$\text{Acid} = 20 \times 0.8 = 16L$
$\text{Water} = 4L$
$\frac{16}{20+W} = \frac{50}{100} = \frac{1}{2}$
$32 = 20 + W \implies W = 12L$

Exam Takeaway: Mixture dilution wale sawalo me non-changing element (Acid) ko equate karke seedha volume nikal lena hota hai.

ElementStatus
AcidConstant (16L)
WaterAdded
